element.reason: Pick (L1-equivalent stock select) of reactflow/base-node@20261103, the reference the manifest maps to components.flow.node-header: base-node.tsx ships byte-identical to the pinned components.flow.base-node v1 file, which exports BaseNodeHeader and BaseNodeHeaderTitle. v1 carried only LICENCE.md and a meta.reexport, so it had no code file to mount and Studio showed no specimen; v2 ships the code and a preview fixture that mounts BaseNodeHeader with a BaseNodeHeaderTitle inside a BaseNode, the context the header is drawn in.
